remarks: Rare opportunity to own a 3-bedroom mid city penthouse. This expansive 1,700 sq ft residence offers a seamless single-level floor plan. Enjoy breathtaking sunsets as well as city and water views from the privacy of your freshly painted home. The screened-in balcony is a natural extension of the living space, making it easy to step outside for a breath of fresh air. A combination of great closets and thoughtfully designed built-ins throughout the unit provide abundant storage. The penthouse comes with two convenient indoor parking spaces, providing ease and security. Improvements in the last 5 years include a new electrical panel, new hot water heater, new flooring in the main living areas, a new washing machine and a new refrigerator. The building boasts an outdoor pool for those warm days and a fully-equipped exercise room to maintain your active lifestyle. Located just moments away from dining, shopping, and essential transport links, including the train station and major highways, this residence offers unparalleled convenience.
